Our Approach

Healing the mind, elevating the soul, serving humanity.

Since 2016, Chakshu Foundation has practiced what we call the Chakshu Approach — contemporary behavioural science integrated with Indian Indigenous Psychology, the Bhagavad Gita, Upanishadic thought, and the Dvaita Vedanta of Sri Madhvacharya.

🧠

Psychology

Individual, couple, family and child counselling, psychotherapy, psychometric assessment, career and crisis intervention — grounded in evidence-based practice.

🪷

Spirituality

Meditation, mindfulness, breathwork, and psycho-spiritual counselling drawn from the Gita, Upanishads, Ramayana and Mahabharata.

🤝

Community

Corporate wellness, school and college programmes, and rural and community outreach — serving over 3,200 individuals through complimentary COVID-era support alone.

Founder & Director
The Person Behind It

Pavan M. Srivatsa

Counselling Psychologist · Consulting Psychotherapist · Case Supervisor · Researcher · Corporate Trainer · Public Speaker

Since founding Chakshu Foundation in 2016, Pavan has led its vision of delivering accessible, evidence-informed, value-based mental health services to individuals, families, institutions, and communities.

His practice integrates contemporary behavioural science with Indian Indigenous Psychology, the Bhagavad Gita, Upanishadic thought, and the Dvaita Vedanta of Jagadguru Sri Madhvacharya — a distinctive synthesis he calls the Chakshu Approach.

During the COVID-19 pandemic, he led a community initiative offering complimentary psychological counselling and emotional support to more than 3,200 individuals and families.

"True transformation occurs not merely by reducing distress, but by cultivating clarity, character, resilience, and purposeful living."
